risk_note: RV2 (catalog). B1-28j wires the hot list's production upstream (infra/hot-rank-wiring.ts) to union's material-channel ranking port createUnionChannelRanking (B1-22p) in place of B1-28h's outage TODO (BR-TEXT-17 联盟物料频道): categories / page through the port, channel order, sales text and hasMore as given, refs derived as search-wiring does; the whitelist is read again before each fetch (not listed / not selectable → 50304 rank_unavailable, no union call, one warning); an unregistered platform or an adapter without the channel methods is a union outage (50304 without reason). B1-28h's use case and cache are unchanged; catalog.module.ts injects GovernedUnion and CATALOG; app.module.ts and union untouched. Demo adapter only, no platform payloads (CAP-*-10 unrecorded); the whitelist is empty today, so production still answers rank_unavailable first. Known limit (S2, out of scope, followups): an entry without a product key is dropped, so later ranks move up one (D10-422 gap needs a use-case change). No money moves. verify:fast exit 0 (27 rule tests pass); the full verify on the test machine hit 3600 s with no failure, so per D10-319 the required CI decides. Codex was unavailable until 11-02, so rule tests and reviews ran on fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36).
